GPU autonomy plans

Narrow, time-bounded envelopes — never a global automation switch

Create plan

Paste the REST plan JSON. It must carry a simulated decision and two distinct approval roles before canary. An approval is accepted only from a verified Kubernetes bearer identity in the requested group; shared tokens and browser sessions cannot approve.
